notes: must cover a topic in pre-1500 history.
All courses will be designated with the geographical and a temporal focus (pre-1500 or post-1500).
All 4000-level HIST courses have a focus on historical research. Select at least 3 semester credit
students to further develop a research project begun in a prerequisite 4000-level course taken in a
prior semester. Make sure to choose 4000-level course(s) in the area you wish to focus on for your
capstone project. Majors are recommended to take a variety of 4000-level HIST courses.
